tldr: Sunday weekend run: US stocks closed July at RECORD highs on a two-day AI-capex relief rally (S&P 7,489.72, Dow's 4th straight winning month), but Friday's hot core PCE (+3.3%) plus stronger spending pushed September-hike odds UP to ~60-65% (from ~53-61%) with the 10Y at a one-year-high ~4.73% — the rate side, not the equity side, is still the core risk to the book (levered silver, SGX REITs, HK tech).

The hot PCE lifted the USD to a 3-week high and knocked the metals off their highs: gold ~-1.5% to ~$4,045, silver ~-2.2% to ~$57.8 into the weekend — a real-rate/dollar pullback, NOT a thesis break (both near record/multi-year ground). Silver's larger drop is the higher-beta tell: keep favoring gold-heavy GDX over pure silver leverage and hedge the silver-vs-gold spread.

Weekend geopolitics: a Qatari-LNG tanker (Gaslog Shanghai) was struck transiting the Strait of Hormuz on 1 Aug (Iran also claimed interdictions), keeping the strait near-shut and the US-Iran pause broken even as a 10-day ceasefire is floated (Iran denies agreeing) — oil firm (Brent ~$90); watch the Sunday oil / Monday Asia reopen.

AI-capex is re-validated for the HK-tech chip leg — Amazon's AWS +37% and $720-745bn combined hyperscaler 2026 capex reversed the >$1trn semis rout — but Burry's ongoing NVDA/MU/AMAT/SOXX short campaign is the standing valuation warning; keep Tencent/Xiaomi (buybacks paused into Tencent's 12 Aug blackout) as the core over the SMIC chip leg.

Crypto stayed soft over the weekend (BTC ~$63k, ETH ~$1,865, crypto Fear&Greed 27; BTC ETFs bled, ETH ETFs drew inflows) — its failure to break higher despite the equity records flags the rate backdrop capping risk appetite.

No new smart-money filings: Q2 13Fs are due 14 Aug (Ackman teases four un-named new positions); intel/investors/flows re-verified and carried forward with honest stamps. China: PBOC weekend meeting, LPR seen unchanged a 14th month as Q2 GDP cools to a 3.5-yr-low 4.3%.
